svg.title: Target Vector Generation Phase and Training Phase Diagram
svg.desc: Two-panel pipeline diagram. Top frame contains target vector generation phase with M-step bracket, two grid vector illustrations, arrows and a dotted rounded output block D listing unsafe prompts and nudity vector. Bottom frame contains training phase with text encoders, prompt text, target/original/neutral vector nodes, dashed connections, losses and vector formulas.

g.desc: First target-vector plot: grid with an unsafe vector origin near lower-left center, generated gray/green target vectors downward-left, red nudity cluster upward-right, blue selected safe vector, labels and alpha sweep.
Second plot shows selected safe vector origin with many safe blue circles, red unsafe crosses, green/gray generated target vectors sweeping leftward and upward, and alpha labels at 50, 100, 200, 300.
